name: context-compress
description: Keep large tool output searchable without flooding the agent context window.

interface.shortDescription: Compress tool output before it enters context.
interface.longDescription: Run commands, fetch pages, index large outputs, and search the retained data through an MCP server so agents see concise answers instead of raw logs.
defaultPrompt: Run tests through context-compress and summarize failures.
Index this large output and search it for root causes.
Audit this session for raw tool output waste.
